business_summary: Planet, Inc. engages in the standardization of data interchange among companies in Japan. It offers electronic data interchange (EDI) for enterprise systems and procurement; web-EDI; and MITEOS, etc. The company also supports and manages data, such as codes and contact information about retailers, wholesalers, product information of CPG, and package inserts and instructions for OTC medicines, as well as offers a service that streamlines the work involved in product master registration. In addition, it provides Buyers' Net, an information provision service that enables the perusal of data, such as product information, industry news, and the campaigns of various companies. Planet, Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
